description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Irelia''' sends a blade to the target location for 3.5 seconds. ''Flawless Duet'' can be recast after 0.15 seconds while the blade is active, and does so automatically at the end of its duration.
description.text: Active: Irelia sends a blade to the target location for 3.5 seconds. Flawless Duet can be recast after 0.15 seconds while the blade is active, and does so automatically at the end of its duration.

description2.raw: '''Recast:''' '''Irelia''' sends a second blade to the target location, or to her current position if ''Flawless Duet'' was recast automatically.
description2.text: Recast: Irelia sends a second blade to the target location, or to her current position if Flawless Duet was recast automatically.

description3.raw: Once both blades have been placed, they fly toward each other regardless of distance and converge over 0.25 seconds, afterwards dealing magic damage to all enemies within a line between them and [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stunning]] them for 0.75 seconds, during which they are [[File:Reveal icon.png|20px|link=Sight#Standard sight|An icon representing the keyword Standard sight]] [[:Sight#Standard sight|revealed]].
description3.text: Once both blades have been placed, they fly toward each other regardless of distance and converge over 0.25 seconds, afterwards dealing magic damage to all enemies within a line between them and stunning them for 0.75 seconds, during which they are revealed.

description4.raw: ''Flawless Duet's recast can be used during [[File:Irelia Bladesurge.png|20xpx|border|link=Irelia#Bladesurge|An icon for Irelia's ability Bladesurge]] [[Irelia#Bladesurge|Bladesurge]] and the cast time of [[File:Irelia Vanguard's Edge.png|20xpx|border|link=Irelia#Vanguard's Edge|An icon for Irelia's ability Vanguard's Edge]] [[Irelia#Vanguard's Edge|Vanguard's Edge]], but is not used automatically while she is affected by [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Crowd_control#Disrupting|An icon representing the keyword Cast-inhibiting crowd control]] [[:Crowd_control#Disrupting|cast-inhibiting crowd control]] or a [[File:Lockout icon 2.png|20px|link=Terminology#Lockout|An icon representing the keyword Lockout]] [[:Terminology#Lockout|lockout]] that disables abilities. Each of the blades' travel times are 0.264 seconds.''
description4.text: Flawless Duet's recast can be used during Bladesurge and the cast time of Vanguard's Edge, but is not used automatically while she is affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control or a lockout that disables abilities. Each of the blades' travel times are 0.264 seconds.

notes.raw: * Both casts count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]] and triggering [[File:Kassadin Force Pulse.png|20xpx|border|link=Kassadin#Force Pulse|An icon for Kassadin's ability Force Pulse]] [[Kassadin#Force Pulse|Force Pulse's]] passive. ** If the ability is not manually recasted, the secondary effect will trigger and it will be considered as an ability activation. This is the only ability with this interaction in the game. * ''Flawless Duet'' will recast automatically at its end during [[File:Irelia Defiant Dance.png|20xpx|border|link=Irelia#Defiant Dance|An icon for Irelia's ability Defiant Dance]] [[Irelia#Defiant Dance|Defiant Dance]] despite being disabled. * ''Flawless Duet'' will also recast automatically upon entering [[File:Revival icon.png|20px|link=Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|An icon representing the keyword Resurrection]] [[:Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|resurrection]]. * The outgoing blades will stop flight upon touching [[File:Projectile.png|20px|link=Projectile|An icon representing the keyword Projectile]] [[:Projectile|projectile]] blocking effects. The converging blades will instead be destroyed upon contact with such effects. ** The blades will not stun nor deal damage if they fail to converge (i.e [[File:Yasuo OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Yasuo|An icon representing Yasuo]] [[Yasuo|Yasuo's]] [[File:Yasuo Wind Wall.png|20xpx|border|link=Yasuo#Wind Wall|An icon for Yasuo's ability Wind Wall]] [[Yasuo#Wind Wall|Wind Wall]]). * Both of ''Flawless Duet's'' casts will be buffered and cast when their cooldowns end if the player attempts to cast each within 0.3 seconds of their cooldown ending.
notes.text:
Both casts count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
* If the ability is not manually recasted, the secondary effect will trigger and it will be considered as an ability activation. This is the only ability with this interaction in the game.
Flawless Duet will recast automatically at its end during Defiant Dance despite being disabled.
Flawless Duet will also recast automatically upon entering resurrection.
The outgoing blades will stop flight upon touching projectile blocking effects. The converging blades will instead be destroyed upon contact with such effects.
* The blades will not stun nor deal damage if they fail to converge (i.e Yasuo's Wind Wall).
Both of Flawless Duet's casts will be buffered and cast when their cooldowns end if the player attempts to cast each within 0.3 seconds of their cooldown ending.
